Hypothesis from the vulnerability description: exploiting 'CVE-2026-115961 - WordPress B Slider plugin <= 2.2.2 - Cross Site Scripting (XSS' could enable Steal Web Session Cookie (T1539) in the Credential Access phase. mitre_techniques.detection_hint: Monitor for JavaScript accessing document.cookie in unexpected contexts. Alert on session tokens appearing from new IPs after authenticated session.
